listings.content: You can enjoy this beautiful lake, Ilgam-ho M-F only 05:00-08:00, because of the students' security. But you can visit here at 05:00-17:00 every weekends.

listings.name: Seoul Pungmul Market
listings.content: Seoul Pungmul Market is a traditional market which originated from Hwanghakdong market famous for flea market. You can buy and enjoy the traditional and also modern items at here.

listings.name: Water Museum
listings.content: There is an exhibition where you can see the growth and development of water supply-related culture and technology. There are also various facilities to experience.

listings.name: Seoul Imagination Country
listings.content: It is a space where you can experience various experience facilities through children's play.

listings.name: Cheonggyecheon Museum
listings.content: You can see the history and culture of Cheonggyecheon Stream. You can also see how Cheonggyecheon affected human life through the exhibition.

listings.name: Kyung Hee University
listings.content: A private research university with campuses in Seoul and Suwon. Founded in 1949, it is widely regarded as one of the best universities in South Korea. Kyung Hee University offers comprehensive education from kindergarten through graduate school.
listings.image: Kyung Hee Univ. Administration Building(Seoul Campus).JPG

listings.name: University of Seoul
listings.content: A municipal public university that is famous in South Korea for a very large number of alumni working as national or municipal government officials. UOS is specialized in urban science and has top-tier programs environmental engineering, taxation, transportation engineering, urban planning and design, landscape architecture, and urban administration.

listings.name: Hanyang University
listings.content: A private research university in Seoul and Ansan (ERICA campus). The university was founded in 1939 as an engineering school, and was the country's first college to offer engineering and architecture programs.

listings.name: Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP)
listings.content: It is a modern landmark with unique curved architecture and exhibitions of art, fashion, and culture. When the lights are on at night, you can enjoy a more fantastic atmosphere.

listings.name: Sejong Center for the Performing Arts
listings.content: Sejong Cultural Center is a representative cultural art space located in Sejong-daero, Jongno-gu, Seoul, and art facilities, and exhibitions, and exhibitions, and exhibitions are regular cultural centers.

listings.name: Seoul City Wall
listings.content: Detailed information and trail guidance on the eastern section of Hanyangdoseong and nearby traditional houses can be found on the Seoul Cultural Heritage website and the blog related to the visit to the city.

listings.name: Seoul Brewery
listings.content: Seoul Brewery is a craft beer brewery located in Seongsu-dong, Seongdong-gu, Seoul, where you can enjoy a variety of homemade beers. It is great to spend quality time with friends or lovers in a hip and comfortable atmosphere

listings.name: Jungnangcheon Stream
listings.content: Regarding Jungnangcheon Ecology, the ecological tour accompanied by commentators provides program information from environmental groups and Seoul's environmental protection sites.

listings.name: Children's Grand Park
listings.content: Neung-dong, Gwangjin-gu. The park was opened in 1973. The park has a zoo, amusement facilities and restaurants. To get there, simply take the subway to Children's Grand Park on line 7. Avoid the weekends as it can get very crowded.

listings.name: Ttukseom Hangang Park
listings.content: You can take a walk and have a picnic.

listings.name: Lotte Cinema
listings.content: The movie theater is easily accessible. There is also a food court next to the movie theater.

listings.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace Visit
listings.content: Gyeongbokgung Palace was the first and largest of the royal palaces built during the Joseon Dynasty. Built in 1395, Gyeongbokgung Palace was located at the heart of the newly appointed capital of Seoul (then known as Hanyang) and represented the sovereignty of the Joseon Dynasty. The largest of the Five Grand Palaces (the others being Gyeonghuigung Palace, Deoksugung Palace, Changgyeonggung Palace, Changdeokgung Palace), Gyeongbokgung served as the main palace of the Joseon Dynasty.

listings.name: Bike riding and walking in Hangang Park
listings.content: You can rent a bike at Han River Park near Ttukseom and Achasan Mountain and ride along the riverside or enjoy a quiet walk.

listings.name: Traditional Crafts Experience Center
listings.content: Located within Bukchon Hanok Village, the Traditional Crafts Experience Center is a place where you can experience traditional crafts firsthand. You can participate in various programs without reservation, and you can experience various things such as making accessories with traditional patterns and Korean paper crafts.

listings.name: Pizza Hill
listings.content: An excellent pizzeria. As its name implies, the restaurant has a lovely view of Seoul on top of a hill and prices higher than the hill it sits on. Worth a visit if you hit it big at the nearby casino.

listings.name: Shinto Buli Tteokbokki
listings.content: Tteokbokki, a Korean dish, is delicious here. It's spicy, so be careful.

listings.name: Ewha dumplings
listings.content: This is the most famous dumpling restaurant in Gwangjin-gu. It sells out early almost every day, so it's best to get there when it opens.

listings.name: YIYIYO
listings.content: A restaurant that serves sashimi, sushi, and rice bowls. There's always a wait, so I recommend getting there early to get on the waiting list and snapping photos at the selfie shop next door.

listings.name: Seobukmyeonok
listings.content: It specializes in Pyongyang noodles, a North Korean-style cold noodle.

listings.name: Mibundang
listings.content: A place that sells rice noodles. It feels like a mix between Korea and Japan.

listings.name: SiongMao
listings.content: This is an Asian restaurant that you can enjoy comfortably anytime

listings.name: SeongsuOnsil
listings.content: This is a fusion pasta restaurant located near Ttukseom Station, featuring creative menu composition and warm interior. This place is popular with unique menus using Korean ingredients such as steak truffle cream pasta and basil pasta, and is highly willing to revisit due to its reasonable price point and friendly service.

listings.name: Darobe
listings.content: This place is a hot place in Seongsu-dong, and it is popular to have hot pot pizza and pasta made with fresh ingredients. There are a variety of menus, including Margherita pizza and shrimp pasta, and it is especially praised for the chewy texture of dough and the flavor of cheese.

listings.name: YeoneoRopda Seongsu
listings.content: This place makes and serves food with fresh salmon and ingredients every day.

listings.name: No more pizza Seoulsup
listings.content: This place uses patented salt milk dough to eat moist and crispy dough compared to other companies. Most of all, the leftover pizza is frozen and you can enjoy the same quality of taste the next day using an air fryer. This place has appeared on many TV shows.

listings.name: Harinezumi
listings.content: A Korean-style izakaya serving sake.

listings.name: Jazzy Lounge
listings.content: A bar where you can enjoy cocktails with live entertainment.

listings.name: Slowtown Brewery(느린마을 양조장)
listings.content: It's a Korean-style bar that serves makgeolli, a Korean liquor, as well as sueyuk and seafood pajeon.

listings.name: Betong Seongsu
listings.content: This is a cafe that is famous for its delicious salt bread. Many people line up to buy and eat bread.

listings.name: Mareulli
listings.content: This is a large cake cafe with a size of 140 pyeong.This place is professional and makes cakes with fresh fruits and top-notch ingredients every day.

listings.name: Jayeondo SogeumPpang in Seongsu
listings.content: A salt bread shop in Seongsu that specializes in freshly baked salt bread and reportedly sells thousands of pieces a day.

listings.name: Reopeu Reopeu
listings.content: This is a cafe specializing in cheesecake located 5 minutes walk from Seongsu Station.This place is rich in original cake menus such as strawberry crumble cheesecake and salty caramel cheesecake, and hole cake pre-order is also available.

listings.name: ChailDiswi
listings.content: This is a Seongsu-dong cafe that offers unique menus such as mango bingsu and salt bread sandwiches.In particular, raw mango shaved ice is large and fresh, and Jambong Bör sandwich and egg mayo sandwich using salt bread are also popular menus.The interior of the store is spacious and comfortable, and it is loved by various visitors because it can be accompanied by pets.

listings.name: Saeseoul
listings.content: A stylish bar in the Ikseon-dong area offering creative cocktails inspired by Korean flavors. The relaxed yet refined atmosphere makes it popular for evening drinks and late-night conversations.

listings.name: The Griffin Bar
listings.content: An upscale rooftop lounge bar located inside the JW Marriott Dongdaemun Square Seoul. It features city views, classic cocktails, and a polished hotel-bar atmosphere.
listings.address: JW Marriott Dongdaemun Square Seoul, Cheonggyecheon-ro

listings.name: Jean Frigo
listings.content: A well-known cocktail bar specializing in refined, well-balanced classic and signature drinks. The intimate interior and professional bartending attract both locals and visitors.

listings.name: Craftroo
listings.content: A casual craft beer bar focusing on Korean and international draft beers. It is a relaxed spot suitable for trying a variety of beers without a formal bar setting.

listings.name: D.CAFE
listings.content: A quiet café near Dongdaemun offering coffee, desserts, and a simple menu. It is suitable for daytime breaks or casual meetings away from crowded shopping areas.

listings.name: Endlong
listings.content: A neighborhood café in Sinseol-dong known for its minimalist interior and specialty coffee. It is popular with locals looking for a calm space during the day.

listings.name: Seosulla-gil Hanok Café
listings.content: A traditional-style café set in a renovated hanok along Seosulla-gil. Visitors can enjoy drinks in a historic atmosphere that contrasts with nearby modern streets.

listings.name: Grand Walkerhill Seoul
listings.content: Luxury hotel famous for its casino, swimming pool and seasonal dance parties. Populated with a lively crowd of regular expats.

listings.name: Vista Walkerhill Seoul
listings.content: Trendy boutique hotel in Seoul. Has a good Sunday brunch buffet with two seatings at 11:00 and 13:30.

listings.name: The Classic 500 Pentaz
listings.content: A landmark in Gwangjin-gu, this residential-style hotel offers the highest level of service.

listings.name: Hotel The Designers Cheongnyangni
listings.content: Hotel The Designers Cheongnyangni is conveniently located 656 feet from Exit 4 of Cheongnyangni Subway Station (Line 1 and Gyeongui-Jungang Line). This modern hotel houses an in-house restaurant and 80 stylish guest rooms. Free WiFi is available in all areas. Each of the 80 rooms is fitted with a TV with cable channels, a fridge and an electric kettle. Private bathroom has a bath, a shower and a toilet with electronic bidet. Extras include bottled water and a hairdryer. The hotel serves daily complimentary breakfast buffet at the in-house restaurant. The hotel also provides 24-hour front desk services. From the hotel, the lively Dongdaemun shopping district is a 10-minute subway ride west on Line 1. Gyeongdong Market is 0.6 mi west and Hongreung Arboretum is 0.9 mi north of the hotel. Incheon International Airport is an hour’s drive away.

listings.name: Golden City Hotel Dongdaemun
listings.content: Golden City Hotel Dongdaemun offers modern guestrooms with free WiFi and on-site parking. Dongdaemun shopping area is a 25-minute drive, while Myeongdong is a 30-minute drive from the hotel. Each room here is equipped a TV, a fridge and a work desk. The private bathroom features a walk-in shower and a hairdryer Guests can purchase simple necessities at the 24-hour convenience store on the ground floor. Semi-buffet breakfast is served daily at the restaurant on the basement floor.

listings.name: The Recenz Dongdaemun Hotel
listings.content: Featuring views of the city, each room is carpeted and fitted with a TV, safety deposit box, desk and fridge. Private bathroom includes free toiletries, slippers and a hairdryer. The hotel features a restaurant, conference rooms and a business center. There is also a 24-hour front desk that offers luggage storage, valet parking and currency exchange services.

listings.name: Saturn Hotel
listings.content: All guest rooms come with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with cable channels, a fridge, a coffee machine, a shower, free toiletries and a closet. The hotel has some rooms with city views, and all rooms have an electric tea pot. All rooms feature a private bathroom, a hairdryer and bed linen.Saturn Hotel(동대문 새턴호텔) also provides a business center and guests can use the fax machine and photocopier at the accommodation.

listings.name: Mangrove Sinseol
listings.content: Mangrove Sinseol provides accommodation with a fitness center, private parking, a shared lounge and a terrace. Featuring a restaurant, the 3-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, each with a private bathroom. The property has a shared kitchen, a business center and currency exchange for guests.At the hotel, rooms include a closet. At Mangrove Sinseol every room comes with bed linen and towels.

listings.name: G Mini Hotel Dongdaemun
listings.content: All rooms are equipped with air-conditioning, a flat-screen cable TV and an electric kettle. Private bathroom comes with a hairdryer and free toiletries. The 24-hour front desk provides currency exchange and ticket services. Guests can request grocery delivery service or request shuttle service here at a surcharge.

listings.name: Hostel Metro
listings.content: Fitted with air conditioning and heating, all guestrooms come with a TV and a mini-fridge. The private bathroom is equipped with a sink and a shower. At the 24-hour front desk, guests can store luggage or request for fax/photocopying services.

listings.name: Hotel Forestar
listings.content: All units are equipped with air conditioning, a TV with cable channels, a fridge, an electric tea pot, a bidet, free toiletries and a desk. With a private bathroom equipped with a bath and a hairdryer, rooms at the hotel also provide guests with free Wi-Fi, while selected rooms include a city view. Guest rooms include a closet. Free private parking and a business center are available, as well as a 24-hour front desk.

listings.name: Hotel Cullinan Wangsimni
listings.content: Featuring a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer, rooms at the hotel also feature free WiFi. The reception at Hotel Cullinan Wangsimni can provide tips on the area.

listings.name: Just Stay Hotel
listings.content: Hotel provides a shared lounge, non-smoking rooms, free WiFi and a bar. This 2-star motel offers a shared kitchen and a 24-hour front desk. Guests can have a drink at the snack bar. All guest rooms in the motel are equipped with an electric tea pot. At Just Stay Hotel every room has air conditioning and a flat-screen TV.

listings.name: April 19t National Memorial Cemetery
listings.content: Dedicated to the tragic events in 1960 which are now considered the roots of modern Korean democracy. 224 people were killed during the April 19 Movement, and were buried in this cemetery. It became a national cemetery in 1995. This place has a museum, several statues, and a mausoleum. It is a popular park to learn about culture and heritage.

listings.name: Dream Forest Park
listings.content: Dream Forest, one of the largest parks in northern Seoul, spans 660,000 square meters and features various attractions, including a lake, art galleries, and an observatory offering panoramic views of the city and surrounding mountains. The park was built on the former site of Dreamland, an amusement park, and is designed to provide a blend of natural and cultural spaces for visitors. Its highlights include the Wolgwang Waterfall, a deer park, and themed gardens, making it a popular spot for families and tourists.

listings.name: Korea Furniture Museum
listings.content: 2,000 pieces of traditional furniture and ten traditional Korean houses on display. Visits by guided tour only, which has to be booked beforehand. You can get there by bus 02 after getting off at Hansung University Station using Line 4.

listings.name: Dooly Museum
listings.content: It is a museum that exhibits Korean famous cartoon Dooly.

listings.name: Nowon Mathematics Culture Center
listings.content: Nowon Mathematics Culture Center is an experience-oriented cultural center, and has a variety of contents to help you easily and enjoy math away from problem-solving math learning.

listings.name: Kimsuyoung Literary Museum
listings.content: It was built in Dobong-gu, the former residence of Korean poet Kim Suyoung, and contains his main house, tomb, and monument. The Dobong Public Literary Center was established by the Dobong District Office in Seoul to honor the legacy of poet Kim Soo-young, who lived and worked in the area. Located on Haedong-ro 32-gil, the center displays handwritten manuscripts, poetry collections, translations, and a bust of Kim, as well as a reconstruction of his study.

listings.name: Eunpyeong Hanok Village
listings.content: It is a modern hanok village. There are Bukhansan Mountain and Jingwansa Temple near the hanok village. Since it is a private area where residents live, noise activities should be refrained from during the night after sunset.
listings.price: Adult ₩7,000, ₩5,000 for youth & children (5-19 years old)

listings.name: Korean Stone Museum
listings.content: It is a museum of stone artifacts from South Korea. It displays historical relics and sculptures related to stones.

listings.name: Bukhansan
listings.content: The highest peak in Seoul, at 836.5 m. Close to the summit, standing above Seoul, is one of the starkest nature/urban divides in the world. These hiking trails are the most visited of the world, with friendly local hikers.

listings.name: Surak San
listings.content: This is a mountain that connects Dobongsan Mountain and Bukhansan Mountain. If you want a simple climb, it's the right one.

listings.name: Dobongsan
listings.content: This is a stone mountain. Many professional hikers visit the mountain and it is quite famous among the mountains of Korea.

listings.name: Jungrangcheon
listings.content: The stream is connected from Uijeongbu to the Han River and is connected to other areas in the middle. There are bicycle roads and exercise equipment. There are also many life and plants. The scenery is lovely.

listings.name: BuramSan
listings.content: The mountain is monotonous, but the combination of huge rock walls, cliffs, and lush trees gives it a beautiful scenery. There are many people who visit to see the sunrise as well.

listings.name: Seongbuk cheon
listings.content: It is a small river in Seongbuk-gu. It is a good place to take a walk along the river or to spend time with small cafes around the river.

listings.name: Suyeon Sanbang
listings.content: A tea house located in an old traditional wooden house which used to be the home of the writer Lee Tae-Jun. Try the jujube (red dates) tea and the pumpkin desserts while admiring the picturesque garden. There are only very few tables available, so it pays off to come early to get one of the good tables at the window. This place is quite expensive and having a tea for two with dessert will cost you around ₩20,000.

listings.name: Foodieshill
listings.content: This is a buffet. Japanese food, Chinese food, Korean food, dessert, and so on. You'd better make a reservation because there are many waiting guests.

listings.name: May dining
listings.content: The restaurant needs to go deeper into view. This place looks like a very fine restaurant. There is a garden and a nice building and you can eat course food. The feel can be shared.

listings.name: Musuok
listings.content: It is a representative restaurant in Dobong-gu. It was introduced very much on TV. Seolleongtang is a good restaurant. Seolleongtang is a Korean traditional food. Suggest.

listings.name: Matsumura Tonkatsu Main Store
listings.content: It's a pork cutlet restaurant. Word of mouth, second and third stores have sprung up. Handmade pork cutlet and the amount for one day is fixed.

listings.name: Little Bangkok
listings.content: It is a place where you can eat Thai food such as Pad Thai.

listings.name: Bubu Shef
listings.content: It is a place where Italian food is sold, and you can enjoy a variety of Italian food at a low price.

listings.name: Hansungdoe
listings.content: It is a meat restaurant in a small stream in Seongbuk-gu. Pork is sold, and you can eat outside when the weather is nice

listings.name: Gupo Noodle
listings.content: It is a restaurant that sells Korean food such as banquet noodles, bossam, jeon, and samhap.

listings.name: Suragio Naengmyeon
listings.content: It is a 21-year-old naengmyeon specialty restaurant that boasts a clean and cool taste using water-based broth. Along with a variety of naengmyeon menus, side menus such as dumplings and pork cutlet are also served, and the inside of the store is clean and spacious, and there is a waiting area along with friendly service.

listings.name: Honam Haemultang
listings.content: This is a seafood restaurant that many locals visit.

listings.name: Jjajang and Udong
listings.content: This is a Chinese restaurant that makes its own noodles every morning. Its attractions are sweet and sour pork and kkangpunggi, which are fried on the fly, and it is cooked by a Chinese master with more than 40 years of experience.

listings.name: Tuna Ga
listings.content: Located near Suraksan Station, the tuna restaurant serves a wide variety of tuna sections and is gaining popularity for its fresh ingredients and cost-effective unlimited refill menu. Inside the store, there is a neat and private room, perfect for group gatherings or special occasions.

listings.name: Hongga's Braised pollack
listings.content: This store specializes in pollack soup and pollack intestine soup, and the broth is cool and rich in ingredients, making it perfect for hangovers. The side dishes are seasoned appropriately to suit your taste, and additional hand-made sujebi is served for you to enjoy more deliciously. It is recommended as a menu that makes you especially crave soup on rainy days.

listings.name: Tteoksan
listings.content: A snack bar specializing in Busan-style garaetteok tteokbokki, it features thick seasoning and chewy garaetteok cooked in a cauldron. It can be taken out and delivered, and it is perfect for enjoying a light meal with a variety of fried foods and sundae menus. With friendly service, it has good access to public transportation, and it is a recommended restaurant on many blogs.

listings.name: Migak
listings.content: This store is a malatang and shabu-shabu restaurant that reproduces the local taste of China, offering generous portions at an affordable price, and boasting a spacious and pleasant atmosphere with a multi-layered structure. With a variety of menus, it is a perfect place for dinners and gatherings.

listings.name: Original Dukkeobi House Fire Ojingeo
listings.content: Operated since 1978, it features an instant stir-fry of fresh squid and vegetables. The spicy taste is controllable, and fried rice is recommended as a must-have. It is famous for its fast turnaround and friendly service.

listings.name: Arslonga Yeonsinnae
listings.content: It is a restaurant that offers an atmosphere suitable for celebrating a special day and a variety of menus. It offers lettering pizza and mega-birthday wine optimized for birthdays and anniversaries, with cozy lighting and relaxed seating arrangements for a private meal. In addition, it can be accompanied by a dog, which can accommodate a wide range of customers.

listings.name: illo
listings.content: Located in Yinsinnae, Izakaya offers a variety of sashimi, nabe, and grilled dishes, and is loved by many customers for its cozy atmosphere and friendly service. Cabbage salad and white kimchi served as basic side dishes are especially impressive, and they are popular enough to have wait.

listings.name: Kkulsodam
listings.content: They sell a wide variety of desserts as well as delicious drinks. In addition, there is a cooking class.

listings.name: Saetbeol Bakery
listings.content: The cafe sells various desserts. Dacuaz is the most popular dessert in this cafe. Prices vary from time to time.

listings.name: Onion Mia
listings.content: It is a type of cafe that cannot be seen abroad. Furniture arrangement and lighting are very interesting and emotional.

listings.name: CafeBanghak
listings.content: It is a very quiet cafe next to Banghakcheon. Also, the space is small and comfortable.

listings.name: Saamann Coffee Roasters
listings.content: If it is a small cafe in Seongbuk-dong, you can enjoy a good atmosphere and coffee with various beans

listings.name: magamil
listings.content: It's a small cafe, and you can drink coffee and eat Furutz Sando, the signature of this cafe.

listings.name: komu
listings.content: It is a small cafe in Seongbukcheon Stream where you can drink coffee and eat banana pudding. You can also take a walk in Seongbukcheon Stream nearby.

listings.name: Natadenata
listings.content: It is an egg tart restaurant made by Portuguese locals. There is a lot of waiting, so it may be sold out early.

listings.name: Mongsangga Crepe
listings.content: It is a dessert specialty store that offers a variety of crepe menus using fresh seasonal fruits. With a compact and cozy atmosphere, the store is located in a residential alley with a quiet dessert experience. All crepes basically include milk whipped cream, Nutella, and crunchy toppings.

listings.name: Café Vibe
listings.content: It is a place to enjoy with a dog, and provides a spacious and pleasant environment. It offers a variety of drinks and desserts, especially baked sweet potatoes and salt bread. The inside of the cafe has a neat and cozy atmosphere, providing a comfortable rest area for customers.

listings.name: Dessert Yam Macaroon
listings.content: Dessert Yam is a macaron specialty store that offers macarons in various flavors and character designs. There are special flavors such as salt vanilla, yellow cheese, and choco Nutella, and there are also Pokémon and Sanrio macarons, which are great for children to enjoy. They are also popular as gifts due to their reasonable price and friendly service.

listings.name: The Whole Bean
listings.content: As a cafe that offers handmade desserts and a variety of drinks, it features a cozy and neat white-tone interior. It is popular with many visitors as it offers high-quality desserts at reasonable prices. Specifically, watermelon juice and teddy bear madeleine are mentioned as the recommended menu, and they are conveniently located to enjoy various desserts and drinks.

listings.name: Hip Duck Coffee
listings.content: This is a cafe located in Banghak-dong, which means people wait in line and eat.

listings.name: C_Ke
listings.content: The handmade cake shop in Yinnae offers a variety of cakes throughout the season, and cakes using fresh fruits are especially popular. The interior of the store has a cozy and warm atmosphere, making it suitable for quietly enjoying dessert. In addition, it has a takeout service and pre-ordering, making it a perfect choice for anniversaries or special occasions.

listings.name: Flup Coffee
listings.content: It is a space where you can concentrate in a quiet atmosphere, and it features a modern interior with a combination of midnight blue and white. There is a rooftop, so you can spend a leisurely time while enjoying the mountain view, and it provides a variety of coffee and desserts to satisfy visitors. In particular, the signature menu, custard millefeuille, is a combination of crispy pastry and soft custard, and desserts using seasonal fruits are also popular.

listings.name: Cheese Dang
listings.content: This is a takeout store specializing in castella located in Yinnae, offering a wide variety of castella and whipped cream. Castella is soft and moist, and the store is compact and neat. There is a waiting area, and customers can enjoy the different whipped cream to their personal preferences.

listings.name: TheSeol
listings.content: It is a handmade patbingsu restaurant made using 100% domestic red beans from Jirisan Mountain, featuring a combination of soft milk ice and savory red beans. The store is spacious and comfortable, making it easy to visit with friends and family, and offers a simple ordering system through a kiosk and a variety of drinks and desserts.

listings.name: Monodono
listings.content: It provides a comfortable and enjoyable time for visitors with its cute interior and various dessert menus. In particular, there are many cute themed menus such as Hello Kitty Desserts, making it a perfect place for gatherings with family visitors or friends. In addition, it offers a wide range of drinks and desserts, adding to the fun of viewing as there is a space for selling props.

listings.name: 1943 Suyu
listings.content: This is a hot bar for young people in Korea these days. It is a bar run by YouTubers and has a luxurious interior environment.However, Anju is cheap, so you can feel a good atmosphere in the pub at a low price.

listings.name: Osulcha Suyu station branch
listings.content: It is a place where you can drink alone and have a cheap snack.

listings.name: Hanas
listings.content: This bar is the Isakaya House. Anju sells Japanese-inspired snacks such as Sashimi and Denpura.

listings.name: Craft Hans
listings.content: This is a bar which is located in Junggye-dong. You can enjoy various sort of beer like German draft beer or Czchia craft beer. You can eat food like fried chicken or Italian pizza as well.

listings.name: Season Nowon
listings.content: Japanese izakaya gaze is located around Nowon Station, where many restaurants and bars are gathered. You can enjoy raw fish such as flatfish and yellowtail sashimi, as well as fresh flatfish and yellowtail sashimi. In addition to raw fish, beef sukiyagi, fish cake soup, and spicy seafood noodle soup are also prepared. It has a good atmosphere and sells a variety of alcohol. I highly recommend it.

listings.name: Whales pub
listings.content: The pub in Wales is located on the street of a hot spot in Gongneung-dong called Gongtral Park and Gongridan-gil. It sells more than 100 kinds of cocktails, high balls, whiskey, and wine, so you can enjoy a variety of liquor. The Gambas is especially delicious. What is interesting is that it runs a special day every Monday, allowing all outside food to be brought in. It catering to customers who simply want to eat cocktails or enjoy a wider variety of foods and cocktails.

listings.name: Bistro Home
listings.content: It sells a variety of snacks and drinks.

listings.name: Hotel Bay204
listings.content: Free Wi-Fi is available, and you have to pay for the breakfast service

listings.name: Anto
listings.content: Guests can use free fitness, sauna, swimming pool, and outdoor bath.

listings.name: Hotel The Artist Sungshin Women's University
listings.content: There are free Wi-Fi and breakfast services.

listings.name: Boramae Park
listings.content: This former site of the Korean Air Force Academy was, in 1986, turned into a park. Boramae, or hawk in English, symbolizes the Air Force. The size of the park is about 360,000 m², and its sports facilities, a small zoo, a pond, and walking paths are well designed. The huge pond, which is 9,000 m², is surrounded by willow trees and benches, and people love to come. The pond is full of cool shades during the summer, and is spectacular when snow falls in the winter.

listings.name: Nakseongdae Park
listings.content: The park surrounding the Seoul National University, continuing on outside the city borders. Interesting points here include the Anguksa Shrine built in honor of the 10th-century general Gang Gam-chan

listings.name: Seoul National University Museum of Art
listings.content: Contemporary art gallery on the premises of the university. The Museum's main gate was designed by Rem Koolhaas, a famous architect from the Netherlands. Since its reconstruction in 2005, it has been opened with the goal of communication between the university and the community. 3 floors above ground and 3 floors below ground with a total area of 4,486 m², there are no entrances between the spaces so spaces are connected organically. It is a rare open culture space in Korea. There are 250 pieces of artwork and it held various exhibitions.

listings.name: South Seoul Museum of Art
listings.content: Seoul Museum of Art is an artistic space where classical architecture and contemporary art communicate with each other in a variety of colorful and quality exhibitions and downtown areas that are free of charge for the year. It is near Sadang Station on Line 4.

listings.name: Gwaneumsa-Temple
listings.content: This an old temple on Gwanaksan Mountain that has been around since the Silla Dynasty. It has a quiet atmosphere. Founded in 895 (Queen Jinsung 9) by the monk Dosun Guksa in the late Silla era. The present Buddhist temple was reconstructed by the main stone in 1924. Located at the foot of the last peak extending northeast from the main peak of Gwanaksan. It was completed in 1977 as one of the Vibo temples established by Dosun Ambassador, 9 years (895). The name Gwaneumsa-sa Temple means that if you pray to the Guaneum Bodhisattva, the Gwaneum Bodhisattva will receive the Gwaneum Bodhisattva to relieve the rebirth and help the rehabilitation of the Buddha.

listings.name: Seoul National University
listings.content: Seoul National University is the uncontested number one university in South Korea. Its main campus is under Gwanak Mountain. Attending Seoul National University is a dream for Korean middle high school students, and admission is extremely competitive. The university offers various campus tour programs like university student's mentor program and campus guide tour. Souvenirs are sold in the campus's souvenirs shop, such as t-shirts, tumblers, watches, notebooks, mugs.
listings.image: Seoul National University, Former Administrative Building.jpg

listings.name: Horim museum
listings.content: The Horim Museum was opened in Daechi-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, based on the relics and funds presented by Horim Yoon Jang-seop. Then, in March 1996, the museum was expanded and built in Sillim-dong, Gwanak-gu, Seoul, and reopened in May 1999. There are more than 15,000 relics, 60 of which are designated as national cultural assets (8 national treasures and 52 treasures). It is recognized for its excellence in the variety and quality of its collection.

listings.name: Gang gan chan birthplace
listings.content: Gang Gam-chan's birthplace, designated as the 3rd monument of Seoul on August 21, 1974, is the home of general Gang Gam-chan (948-1031), who defeated 100,000 troops of Georan. The birthplace was called Nakseongdae because the big star fell from the sky on the day of birth. There is a three-story stone pagoda of the Goryeo Dynasty that tells the location of Nakseongdae. In 1973, during the cleanup of Nakseongdae, the three-story pagoda was moved to the grounds of Nakseongdae Park Anguksa Temple. In the Goryeo Dynasty, the place name was Geumcheon, and a three-storied pagoda was built to signify the birthplace of the general.

listings.name: Yaksuam
listings.content: Yaksuam, which was registered as Gwanak No. 2 on September 21, 1988, was founded during the King Sejong's era, but was lost during the Imjin War. The first building was built in 10 years (670 years) in King Munmu, the Silla period, and it became a temple in the winter of 1974.

listings.name: Mae Buddha statue
listings.content: This is a statue of Maitreya Buddha from the Joseon Dynasty, carved shallowly into a large cliff rock on the north side of Mt. Gwanak that measures 5 x 6 m. The inscription on the right side of the Buddha shows that it was created due to the donation of the Park San Hoe couple in April 1630. The Buddha has a peculiar posture, sitting obliquely to the left. The head, the hair, and a slim face that looks rather abundant show a good technique. These characteristics are well represented in the slender body and the oval shoulders, etc. The Maami Shunbul is regarded as an epitome 17th-century Joseon Buddha statues.

listings.name: The home of Midang Seo Jeong-joo
listings.content: Midang poet Jeong-joo Seo lived in Gongdeok-dong, Mapo-gu in 1970, and lived for 30 years until he passed away on December 24, 2000. The name of the house built by himself is “Bongsansanbang”. It bears the meaning of the origin of Korean mythology. It is named after Dangun myth that bear became ung woman by eating mugwort and garlic. This place, which is the only remaining birthplace of Midang in Korea, is significant as the last writing space of the poet's life. It is a space where you can find the poet's breath and traces of life.

listings.name: Jaunam
listings.content: Jaunam, which was registered as Gwanak No. 3 on September 21, 1988, is located in the valley of the behind Seoul National University. There is a record of reconciliation in the 13th year of King Yeongjo (1734), and the plaque made by Sungjong for the mother has been transmitted yet.

listings.name: Gwanaksan
listings.content: Gwanaksan (Korean for Mt. Gwanak; 632 m) is a small mountain in southern Seoul, South Korea. Portions lie in the Gwanak-gu and Geumcheon-gu districts of Seoul; other portions lie in the neighboring cities of Anyang and Gwacheon.

listings.name: Gang gamchan Festival
listings.content: Gwanak Ganggamchan Festival is a representative historical and cultural festival held in Seoul to honor the national pride and feats of General Kang Gam-chan, the hero of the Battle of Guju, in "Gang Gam-chan City Gwanak."

listings.name: Gallery Gwanak
listings.content: An exhibition space designed to enable local residents to enjoy high quality cultural life in their daily lives. In 2011, the 2nd floor rest area of ​​the ward office building was renovated and opened to realize the city of emotion and culture and art. It is used as an open space for all residents.

listings.name: Kyujanggak, Korea Research Institute
listings.content: '규 (Kyu)' of Kyujanggak is the name of the star that controls the sentence, and '규장 (Kyujang)' means the emperor's handwriting. Thus, ‘규장각 (Kyujangak)’ means “building that kept the handwritten texts of the king or emperor.” Kyujanggak was first established in 1694 (20th year of King Sukjong), and since its inception in 1776, the function of Kyujanggak has been extended to institutions that nurture talents for the country. Kyujanggak was a treasure of human resources and a cradle of scholarship. In 1990, the current building of Kyujanggak was completed, and the books of Kyujanggak were transferred. In 2006, Seoul National University Kyujanggak and Seoul National University Korea Culture Research Institute were merged into a research institution called Kyujanggak Korean Studies Institute.

listings.name: Nakseongdae Traditional Outdoor Theater
listings.content: The traditional outdoor small theater is a representative tourist attraction of Seoul that presents and experiences Korea's own traditional culture and breezes that are brilliant not only to Gwanak residents but also to Koreans and foreigners. Traditional weddings, traditional game experiences, and etiquette education are held regularly.

listings.name: Gwan-ak mountain Trail road
listings.content: Patriotic Forest Road is one of the Gwanak Mountain Trail road, designed to help you enjoy nature, culture and history while walking along the flat forest path surrounding Gwanak Mountain. Sector distance: 6.2 km (2 hours 40 minutes) Section Description: In connection with Nakseongdae, it can inspire General Kang Gam-chan's patriotism.

listings.name: Sharosu-gil
listings.content: The road name refers to a commercial area centered on a one-way alleyway of about 600 m, corresponding to Gwanak-ro 14-gil. It is a two-sided road that leads to Nakseong University (Inheon Elementary School) exiting Seoul National University Exit No.1 and 2 for subway station. The name parodied Garosu-gil located in Sinsa-dong, Gangnam-gu, and merged with Garosu-gil after taking the 'sha' of the front gate, which is a symbol of Seoul National University.

listings.name: National Memorial cemetery
listings.content: National Memorial Cemetery is reserved for Korean veterans, including those who died in the Korean independence movement, Korean War, and Vietnam War. Four South Korean presidents are buried in the cemetery. It is not only opened for mourners. Anyone can enter the Cemetery. There are large park that you can play even badminton. Especially, in the Spring, the flowers are awesome
listings.address: Seoul National Memorial Board 210, Hyeonchung-ro, Dingjak-gu

listings.name: SEMA
listings.content: A museum exhibition that changes periodically and an art museum that can be viewed free of charge. The building used during the Japanese colonial era in the past has been renewed and is being used as an art museum.

listings.name: Noryangjin Fish Market
listings.content: The floors may be dank and wet, but this is undoubtedly the freshest seafood in Seoul, with live octopuses, spiky sea urchins, giant king crabs swimming about in water tanks, buckets and bags. Buy some fresh fish (try bargaining if you can), and head to the restaurants in the back row, where they'll prepare your food as requested. There's a wholesale auction at 02:00, where fishmongers bid for produce and it can get frantic.

listings.name: Sinsa Market
listings.content: It is a traditional market near Sindaebang Station. It is a market for working-class people selling various products as well as food. In September 2006, as a traditional market revitalization project, arcades were installed with a total of ₩1.7 billion in construction costs over a 300m section, and the old market was transformed into a modernized market. In the meantime, the location of traditional markets is getting smaller due to the economic recession, financial crisis, changes in distribution environment, changes in consumer purchasing patterns, and increase in hypermarkets. It is developing into a receiving market and is playing a pivotal role as an excellent market representing more than 1,500 traditional markets nationwide.

listings.name: Yangji Sundae Town
listings.content: It is a restaurant near Sinlim Station. Sundae is a Korean traditional food. The price is generally low, and it's perfect for drinking. The first place to think of in Sillim-dong, Sundae Town was established in 1967 when Sundae street vendors were naturally formed and opened. And Yangji Sundae Town were formed. Unlike ordinary sundae, it is a specialty of Sillim-dong that young people often look for in a differentiated menu such as spicy sundae mixed with red pepper paste, various vegetables and seasoning, and fried sundae on white sauce.

listings.name: Naksung Butcher's
listings.address: 1850 Southern Circulation Route in Bongcheon-dong, Gwanak-gu, Seoul

listings.name: Ganggangsulae
listings.content: The restaurant's name comes from the traditional Korean game, Ganggangsullae. It is a meat restaurant, and although it is a little expensive, it has the best taste of cold noodles served as meat and dessert.

listings.name: Perilla seeds, Jangsu-Mill
listings.content: Kalguksu, professional restaurant. The taste of spicy soup is excellent, and it is popular at a reasonable price.

listings.name: Nok-du street
listings.content: The street name is derived from the name of the Nok-du Jip (녹두집) that sold Dongdongju in the 1980s and attracted the poor students. At first, pubs and restaurants began to gather around the village, and those who used them were mainly judiciary students preparing for judicial examinations, administrative examinations, and examinations for public officials. However, as time went by, the variety of foods and the low prices made Seoul students come to play often, and now it is actually a playground and gathering place for Seoul students.

listings.name: Jungsung mandoo
listings.content: A dumpling restaurant in the alley before going to Bongcheon-dong Market Street. It hasn't been a long time since its opening, but it's been selling well for years. The dumplings taste not so greasy but light so you can eat a lot without getting tired. You can take out or for there so you can enjoy hot dumplings. And also the price is not expensive.

listings.name: Rami scone
listings.content: Atmospheric Cafe which is located on the Sharosu-gil. You can enjoy various coffee menu and sweets that goes well with coffee. This cafe became famous through Korean famous Youtube channel Wassup man.

listings.name: Yeongilman
listings.content: A Pohang-style makhoe and cold raw fish restaurant that has been in place for 25 years, they feature fresh seafood and unique recipes. In particular, makhoe is served by mixing soybean flour and red pepper paste and wrapping it in seaweed, while cold raw fish is gaining popularity for its style of mixing it with ice. In addition, soju sales per capita are limited, providing an environment where people can enjoy food even more.

listings.name: Our Hoe Pocha Sadang Branch
listings.content: It is a popular sashimi restaurant that offers fresh sashimi and a variety of seafood. The yellowtail is especially famous, and receives good responses from customers as it is served with corn cheese and fish cutlet as basic side dishes. The inside of the store is not spacious.

listings.name: Kiki Gelato
listings.content: This is a handmade gelato specialty store that is made in-store, and sells 12 of 200 different flavors selected every day. The gelato here boasts a chewy and rich taste using Italian ingredients, and the cute character welcomes customers both outside and inside the store. It also offers menus for dogs and can be packaged, making it a dessert place that can be enjoyed in various situations.

listings.name: Apple House Isu
listings.content: It is a snack bar that is famous for its instant tteokbokki and pan-fried mandu in sauce. The store is spacious and clean, and its efficient operation is achieved by introducing a self-service system. Especially, pan-fried mandu in sauce is recommended to many visitors for its crispy texture and addictive seasoning. In addition, a variety of drinks are served through the beverage vending machine, and takeout and delivery services are also available.

listings.name: No Idea Pizza
listings.content: Using homemade dough that has been kneaded in-store, we serve chewy and digestible pizzas. There is a wide variety of unique pizza menus, and buldak sweet potato pizza and combination pizza are especially popular. The atmosphere in the store is young and casual, making it perfect for dates or meeting friends. The self-bar offers water and pickles, and takeout and delivery services are also available.

listings.name: Sushiroro
listings.content: Popular sushi spot with fresh fish and affordable prices, beloved by locals. Great choice for casual Japanese dining in Sadang.

listings.name: Saigon Lee
listings.content: Well-reviewed Vietnamese restaurant offering classic pho and banh mi. A favorite for lunch or light dinner in Dongjak.

listings.name: Ungteori Saenggogi Heukseok
listings.content: Korean BBQ grill house known for quality meats and a lively dinner vibe. Good option for group meals with drinks.

listings.name: Unbong Sanjang
listings.content: Lamb BBQ spot with a unique menu not often found in Seoul; a fun choice for meat lovers.

listings.name: Cocktail&Dream
listings.content: You can enjoy various cocktails like mojito, gin and tonic, martini. Also You can enjoy the price from ₩8,000 to ₩14,000. There are not only cocktail but also many wines. It also offers snacks for wine and cocktails.

listings.name: Doritori
listings.content: Although the price is not cheap, it is a place where you can have a glass of wine at night and have a comfortable meal. You can enjoy various draft beer or sake (Japanese traditional rice wine) with yakitori (chicken barbecue).

listings.name: Kim's real beer
listings.content: You can enjoy a variety of beer and snacks at a low price. It’s signature. Because it is close to the station, it is easy to access the beer. Kim’s draft beer is a 60 hour low-temperature aged beer. And also you can enjoy several snacks like chicken and tteokbokki.

listings.name: HaengBok-Pocha (행복포차)
listings.content: It's a reasonably priced bar. Located close to the station, it is easy to access.

listings.name: Liverpool pub
listings.content: It is a beer pub located in Dongjak-gu. As the name suggests, it is a pub created by a Liverpool fan, and during soccer games, you can watch the game on the screen.

listings.name: Isu Coffee
listings.content: This cafe offers a variety of drinks and desserts in a small space, and features handmade denim and decaffeinated options to control caffeine intake.

listings.name: Café Pipe
listings.content: An emotional cafe located near Isu Station, it offers a variety of desserts and drinks, and features a dessert lineup that changes every day. The interior of the cafe has a cozy and comfortable atmosphere, and as it is located on the first and third floors, it offers a variety of seating options. In particular, Dutch apple pies and pavlova are considered popular menus, and 'Tiffy', a signature drink that combines coffee and tea, is also recommended.

listings.name: Poon
listings.content: Specializing in handmade pudding, it serves both Japanese and American pudding. The interior is decorated with a cozy and cute interior, and you can enjoy pudding with a variety of drinks. In particular, puddings made with special recipes are popular. We recommend visiting early because there are many different kinds of pudding when visiting.

listings.name: On Cloud Nine
listings.content: Located near Sadang Station, the cafe offers a wide variety of desserts and drinks, especially the cute visual Financier and Fruits Sando. With a cozy and comfortable atmosphere inside, it is perfect for family visits as you can accompany your pet. Also, all desserts are homemade and boast freshness.

listings.name: Sadang 1038
listings.content: Located near Sadang Station, the dessert shop specializes in handmade desserts, and uses all ingredients made and used by itself. In particular, it uses French gourmet butter and 100% domestic whipped cream to enhance the quality of its flavor. It offers a wide variety of cakes and baked snacks, and is a perfect place for anniversaries and special occasions as holecakes can also be reserved and ordered in return. The interior of the store is decorated cutely, and there are many customers who prefer to takeout.

listings.name: Yeokjunhalmunimaekju
listings.content: A popular Korean beer pub chain known for its retro atmosphere and affordable draft beer. It is a common after-work spot for locals looking for a casual and lively place to drink.

listings.name: Senghwalmaekju
listings.content: A craft beer pub specializing in Korean microbrews from small regional breweries. Fried chicken and simple bar food make it a good place for a relaxed evening.

listings.name: Cheongchunpocha
listings.content: A youthful pojangmacha-style bar with bright interiors and shared seating. It is especially popular for group drinking.

listings.name: Hanshinpocha
listings.content: A famous late-night bar chain known for spicy dishes and generous portions. It stays open late and attracts large groups.

listings.name: Frienmily
listings.content: Wine bar offering a curated wine list and evenings with friends. Known for its intimate vibe and chill atmosphere.

listings.name: WD Hotel
listings.content: It is a pleasant environment compared to the price range. Breakfast is served.

listings.name: Bongeunsa
listings.content: A Buddhist temple with a long history that was once located on the rural outskirts of Seoul. The surrounding area was transformed during the rapid development of Gangnam from the 1980s, and the temple is now surrounded by high-rise buildings and commercial districts. The grounds contain several Buddhist buildings and sculptures.

listings.name: COEX
listings.content: This state-of-the-art complex combines a massive underground mall, luxury hotels, office towers, convention center, and international trade center. Parts of the mall have aged considerably since its debut, but it still features mid-to-upscale shopping, entertainment, and Korean and Western food options. Popular attractions here include Starfield Library with its towering bookshelves in central atrium, and K-POP Square outside the southeast corner of the mall (a huge digital billboard shows 3d animations every 30 minutes; these can be quite impressive and draw a crowd of spectators). Yearly conventions at the COEX include online gaming conventions (such as the popular Korean-originated MMORPG Lineage), anime conventions, and auto shows. It is possible to spend the entire day in this covered mall without setting foot outside, which can be a blessing if very bad weather hits outside.

listings.name: Seoul Art Center
listings.content: 700 Seocho-dong, Gangnam-gu, (line 3 Nambu Bus Terminal stn). This arts complex contains multiple performing arts and museum exhibition spaces, showcasing Korean traditional art as well as modern works.

listings.name: Yangjae Citizen's Forest
listings.content: On the southern end of Gangnam Street is this large public park featuring playgrounds, performance spaces, sculpture gardens, memorial monuments for the victims of the Sampoong Department Store disaster and the bombing of Korean Air flight 858, and over 106,600 trees. It's a very popular picnic spot for young students and photographers. A little out of the way, but accessible by commuter rail, and it's a nice way to escape the hustle and bustle of Gangnam.

listings.name: Seonjeongneung Royal Tombs
listings.content: Tranquil park in the middle of Gangnam with the burial mounds of two kings and a queen from the Joseon dynasty.

listings.name: Banpo Hangang Park
listings.content: Section of the Han River Park near the Banpo Bridge. The double-decker bridge has become an attraction itself, with the lower deck opening bike and pedestrian access close to the water (sometimes shutting down to automobiles altogether) and the upper deck featuring LED-lit fountain shows in the evening. These shows can best be viewed from the riverbank, which also hosts bike rentals, a water taxi dock, picnic areas, and a night market in the warmer months. Three artificial floating islands called Sebitseom are on the west side of the bridge, containing exhibition spaces and dining options. A parking lot is available from 06:00 to 24:00.

listings.name: Dosan Park
listings.content: This park was created to commemorate Ahn Chang-ho's patriotism and educational spirit, and opened on November 9, 1973, the 95th anniversary of Ahn Chang-ho's birth.

listings.name: Sevit Island
listings.content: It is a beautiful place in the Han River. There is a floating island called Sebit Dongdongseom Island, where you can enjoy various activities such as eating and boat experience.

listings.name: Shinsegae Department Store Gangnam Branch
listings.content: It is a popular shopping spot in Seoul that often hosts famous pop-up stores, always offering new experiences. It is a great place for gourmets as there are many delicious desserts and various restaurants. In addition, you can enjoy high-end brands, lifestyle products, and even cultural experiences in one place. However, as it is a department store, the price is rather high. It is easily accessible by subway and bus, and there is also a convenient parking facility

listings.name: Sea Life COEX, Seoul Aquarium
listings.content: There are various kinds of living things and indoor aquariums that are good to come with family or lovers

listings.name: Heonin Tomb
listings.content: The Tomb of the King of Joseon in the past, which can be seen in Gangnam

listings.name: Seven luck casino
listings.content: Seven Luck Casino Gangnam COEX in the center of Gangnam, SeoulIt is a Korean-style casino with oriental atmosphere and state-of-the-art facilities.It boasts a total of three floors (area 6,094㎡) and operates 78 table games (baccarat, blackjack, poker, roulette, etc.), 108 latest machine games, and 45 electronic tables

listings.name: World Comic Convention
listings.content: Roughly every other month, the SETEC convention center hosts Seoul's World Comic con Festival. Admission is ₩4,000 but the inside is rather bland unless you are extremely familiar with Japanese and Korean anime. Your best bet is to go during convention hours and mingle with the crowds of Korean teenagers in elaborate cosplay costumes dressed as their favorite anime characters. Most are excited to see foreigners and very glad to have their pictures taken. As mentioned, this convention only takes place once every two months, so check the website (Korean only) to make sure it will be in session while you are in Seoul.

listings.name: Seorae Village
listings.content: Seorae Village is a small France in Seoul, where many French people live here, there are French cafes and bakeries, and there are many atmospheric restaurants.

listings.name: Figure Museum W
listings.content: A figure museum that can be enjoyed by various ages, from adults to children who like figures

listings.name: KIA 360
listings.content: It's Kia's brand experience space. The interior is 570 pyeong and consists of a brand & design zone consisting of New Journey, Inspiring Universe, and Opportunity United, an EV life zone where you can experience mobility life in the electrification era, and a customized consultation space for customers considering purchasing a vehicle.

listings.name: 365 days Fun&Fun Gangnam
listings.content: Taekwondo A variety of street performances such as a demonstration of the national flag at the headquarters, and a gugak ensemble at a gugak high school, as well as a variety of audience-participating programs such as random play dance and dance challenge. Usually, the event runs from April to the end of October every year.

listings.name: Hanwoori
listings.content: An upper-end Korean restaurant that specializes in the Korean version of Shabu-shabu, which is a boiling pot to which you throw in vegetables and very thin slices of meat. Their menu is extensive and while their atmosphere may not be cutting-edge, it is classy and clean.

listings.name: Samwon Garden
listings.content: One of the best places in Seoul for Korean-style grilled meat. Lunch menus are recommended for those meat lovers on budget. For dinners, make reservations to avoid disappointment.

listings.name: Brick Oven New York Pizza
listings.content: One of the best if not the best place pizza place in Seoul. On the way up the hill you will see some Chicago-style places as well.

listings.name: Coreanos Kitchen
listings.content: Korean-Mexican fusion. Kimchi burritos, Kimcheese Nachos, Galbi Tacos. The guys who run this place have created some interesting and delicious food, and you'll pay for it.
listings.price: Plan to spend at least ₩15,000 per person
listings.address: 강남구 신사동 657-11 B1 (657-11 B1 Sinsa-dong, Gangnam-gu)

listings.name: Wasshoiken
listings.content: The owner and staff are very friendly. It has a rich broth and a slightly salty taste.

listings.name: Oreno Ramen Gangnam
listings.content: It has clean and savory taste without any gamey flavor from the meal. Noodles, soup, and rice are available for refill.

listings.name: London Bagel Museum
listings.content: It is a very famous bagel bakery in Korea. Koreans wait for more than an hour to eat the bagels, too. You can taste various kinds of bagels, and there may already be a wait because they are well known to tourists. Chives pretzel bagels are the best in this bakery.

listings.name: Haidilao
listings.content: A hot pot franchise that originated in China. It's known for its friendly staff, wide selection of hot pot ingredients, and overall cleanliness. Reservations are required to get in without waiting and a must for groups.

listings.name: Gabedo
listings.content: Our Heterotopia is a small island with coffee in the city center.

listings.name: MOSU Soeul
listings.content: Mosu is a fine-dining restaurant based in Seoul, South Korea and Hong Kong. The food served in the restaurant is a fusion of Korean and other culinary traditions and ingredients.

listings.name: Daebongjib
listings.content: It is a famous pork belly restaurant in Sinsa Station, and it is a pork belly restaurant that is cheap and delicious.

listings.name: Zoosindang Gangnam Branch
listings.content: Along with the luxurious interior, there are 12 animals signature cocktails and dining menus using traditional liquor.

listings.name: Alver
listings.content: As a complex cultural space, there are seats and outdoor terrace, and outdoor terrestrial terrestrial terrestrial terrace.The plant wall and high wind table that can feel cozy and healing atmosphere that can provide cozy and healing atmosphere.

listings.name: Hanwadam black gangnam N Tower
listings.content: A restaurant where you can eat delicious Korean beef

listings.name: YonggaHwogwo Gangnam branch
listings.content: This is a Chinese restaurant, an innovative brand where you can enjoy about 100 kinds of ingredients in your seat without having to wait in line at the self-bar. Based on one bowl per person, you can enjoy a variety of broths, from spicy Sacheon-style malatang to light white soup to deeply brewed mushroom soup. This place has a fascinating system that train robots bring when you sit down.

listings.name: HuchuPoint
listings.content: It is a popular Western restaurant located in Gangnam. Chodang corn gnocchi and Toowoomba pasta are especially loved by many customers, and classic lasagna and pepper steak are also popular dishes. The atmosphere here is modern yet warm, making it suitable for dates and gatherings. Menu prices are reasonable compared to the Gangnam area.

listings.name: MereumilJinmijip Nonhyeon
listings.content: This is a buckwheat specialty restaurant with a 60-year history. It has been running for three generations, and it is a historic place with always many customers.

listings.name: Daedo restaurant GangnamDaero Branch
listings.content: This place has a 60-year-old tradition. It is Korea's representative sirloin restaurant that started in the back alley of Wangsimni, a region famous for its fresh beef in 1964.

listings.name: Ramotta
listings.content: This is a popular restaurant in Sinsa-dong, which serves Italian-style sliced pizza.You can enjoy Italian dishes such as truffle mushroom soup and meatballs along with a variety of pizza menus such as Margherita, Porqueta, and Putanesca

listings.name: Pig Company Gangnam Korean BBQ
listings.content: Pig Company is a pork-focused all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ spot that started in Gangnam, known for cauldron lid grilling and crispy Korean fried chicken made fresh in-house. Built for sharing at the table.

listings.name: Surak Io Naengmyeon
listings.content: Popular local restaurant specializing in spicy cold noodles (naengmyeon) and king pork cutlets near Suraksan.

listings.name: Syoto
listings.content: This is Apgujeong's cake restaurant run by Patissche from the Shilla Sweet Park. Strawberry Shotto and Choco Strawberry Shotto are especially popular, with soft cake sheets and rich in fresh fruits.

listings.name: Flink
listings.content: This is a cafe where bakeries and coffee are delicious. A variety of bakery menus such as croissants and pain au chocolat are popular, especially pain au chocolat, which is rich in chocolate, goes well with coffee.

listings.name: Club Answer
listings.content: House music club with regular events and famous Djs.

listings.name: Woodstock
listings.content: Woodstock Gangnam is a Korean-style music pub (i.e. offering music selection by customers) that specializes in 1960s & 70s rock and blues. It's a nice bar, unchanged for ages, with huge Vinyl and drink selection, laid back and down to earth, unlike any other place in the area. But it's a hidden gem, a bit hard to find.

listings.name: Tokyo Jazz
listings.content: A cozy jazz club on the second floor with live piano and vocal music every night and a jazz combo Thursday and Friday nights 9-12 or later if the club is full. Famous for staying open until the last customer leaves.

listings.name: JJ Bear
listings.content: It is a specialty shop for world beers. With over 20 years of experience, the chef, who has a background in hotel kitchens, offers homemade chicken, craft beer, and dishes that go well with soju, featuring rich and savory flavors. Private rooms are available for groups of 10 or more, and the venue can accommodate group meals for over 100 people.

listings.name: Kathybar
listings.content: Over 100 different types of dazzling cocktails and more than 50 varieties are offered. Inside the store, music videos are played, and dart-playing is available.

listings.name: Wang's pub
listings.content: It's a sports pub in Gangnam. There are screens everywhere, so you can drink beer while watching sports such as the Premier League.

listings.name: Blue Bottle Yeoksam Cafe
listings.content: It is a world-famous cafe and you can taste it in Korea

listings.name: Ichiseoul
listings.content: This is Sinsa Station Cafe, which features a unique dessert made with mugwort and figs. Figs. Earl Grey Parfait and Mugwort Fig Box are well received by visitors for their freshness and harmonious taste of the ingredients

listings.name: Standard Bread Dosan
listings.content: It is a bakery cafe where you can enjoy a variety of bread and drinks in a spacious and pleasant space. The popular combination of Salted Butter Raw Bread and Caymak is popular, and we also recommend the new menu, matcha chocolate french toast and pistachio french toast.

listings.name: ComePrima
listings.content: Come Prima is a café offering a selection of coffee and beverages. The venue provides an indoor seating environment suitable for casual visits and small gatherings. It operates on a regular schedule, with exceptions applied on specific designated days of the month.

listings.name: Jeon-Ga
listings.content: A decent makgeolli bar, with about 8 kinds of makgeolli and very good anju (side dishes for alcohol drinking), including tofu kimchi (dubu kimchi) and "Korean pancake" (전). Very good prices. You can't find it on Google maps, but it's there, next to beauty shop (이철헤어커커 대치점).

listings.name: Quelquechose
listings.content: It is a famous dessert restaurant nationwide. There are many luxurious desserts and they are all famous for their deliciousness.

listings.name: YaKorea Hostel Gangnam
listings.content: An affordable and well-traveled hostel

listings.name: K-Grand Hostel Gangnam1
listings.content: Hostel close to the subway station and reasonably priced

listings.name: Gangnam seven hostel
listings.content: Gangnam seven hostel is an inexpensive and well-located hostel

listings.name: Ibis Hotel Ambassador
listings.content: Convenient for international travellers as it is very close to the check-in and limousine server at KCAT, Korea Air City Terminal, next to the COEX. Free shuttle to KCAT and free wired Internet.

listings.name: Josun Palace Seoul Ganam
listings.content: 5-star hotel. The swimming pool operates on different schedules depending on weekdays, weekends, and holidays. The pepperoni pizza is delicious when ordered through room service. For parking, valet service is available at a fee of 30,000 won.

listings.name: Novotel Ambassador
listings.content: 5-star hotel. The buffet is delicious, and the apple mango shaved ice, which can be enjoyed in the lounge, is a particular specialty.

listings.name: Imperial Palace Hotel
listings.content: Luxury hotel in Gangnam. Shuttle buses from and to Incheon international airport. Very nice spa. A local favourite.

listings.name: JW Marriott Seoul
listings.content: Rooms are stylish and fully-equipped. Spa, gym, sauna, indoor running track complex covers 2 floors in the basement. Olympic-size pool, climbing wall and golf driving range and Maska's cigar shop selling Cubans.

listings.name: Park Hyatt Seoul
listings.content: Upscale hotel that is right across from the COEX shopping complex and host to The Timber House featuring live jazz music.

listings.name: Grand InterContinental Seoul Parnas
listings.content: 5-star hotel. The steak at the buffet is very delicious. The desserts are also very luxurious, and among them, the mango shaved ice can be considered a specialty.
